requirements.required_behavior: Treat LOCAL_PREF as a well-known attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The path attribute classification identifies whether LOCAL_PREF is well-known.

requirements.quote:
LOCAL_PREF is a well-known attribute that SHALL be included in all
   UPDATE messages that a given BGP speaker sends to other internal
   peers.
requirements.condition: a BGP speaker sends an UPDATE message to an internal peer
requirements.required_behavior: Include LOCAL_PREF in every such UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: UPDATE messages generated for internal peers can be checked for LOCAL_PREF presence.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker SHALL calculate the degree of preference for
   each external route based on the locally-configured policy, and
   include the degree of preference when advertising a route to its
   internal peers.
requirements.condition: a BGP speaker calculates the degree of preference for an external route
requirements.required_behavior: Calculate the degree of preference for each external route based on locally configured policy.
requirements.why_checkable: External routes and configured policy inputs can be compared with the calculated preference values.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker SHALL calculate the degree of preference for
   each external route based on the locally-configured policy, and
   include the degree of preference when advertising a route to its
   internal peers.
requirements.condition: a BGP speaker advertises an external route to its internal peers
requirements.required_behavior: Include the calculated degree of preference in the advertisement.
requirements.why_checkable: The advertised LOCAL_PREF value can be compared with the locally calculated preference for the route.

requirements.quote: The higher degree of preference MUST be preferred.
requirements.required_behavior: Prefer the higher degree of preference.
requirements.why_checkable: Route preference comparisons can be checked with unequal preference values.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker uses the degree of preference learned via LOCAL_PREF in
   its Decision Process (see Section 9.1.1).
requirements.condition: a BGP speaker has learned a degree of preference via LOCAL_PREF
requirements.required_behavior: Use the learned degree of preference in the Decision Process.
requirements.why_checkable: The Decision Process inputs can be inspected to verify use of the received LOCAL_PREF value.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker MUST NOT include this attribute in UPDATE messages it
   sends to external peers, except in the case of BGP Confederations
   [RFC3065].
requirements.condition: a BGP speaker sends an UPDATE message to an external peer, except in the case of BGP Confederations
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include LOCAL_PREF in the UPDATE message.
requirements.why_checkable: UPDATE messages sent to external peers outside the confederation exception can be checked for absence of LOCAL_PREF.

requirements.quote:
If it is contained in an UPDATE message that is received
   from an external peer, then this attribute MUST be ignored by the
   receiving speaker, except in the case of BGP Confederations
   [RFC3065].
requirements.condition: an UPDATE message received from an external peer contains LOCAL_PREF, except in the case of BGP Confederations
requirements.why_checkable: An external UPDATE containing LOCAL_PREF can be supplied and its exclusion from receiver preference processing observed.
